timeline.summary: Canara Robeco Asset Management Company Limited revised its conference call on Audited Financial Results for Q4 & FY2026, rescheduled for April 28, 2026, at 10:00 AM (IST) with **Mr. Rajnish Narula, Mr. Ashwin Purohit, Mr. Atit Turakhiya, and Mr. Gaurav Goyal** presenting.
Canara Robeco AMC reported FY26 revenue of ₹425 Cr and PAT of ₹204 Cr, recommending a dividend of ₹2.50 per share.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹114.2 Cr, net profit ₹41.36 Cr.

Canara Robeco Asset Management Company Limited hosted Q4 & FY2026 earnings call on April 28, 2026, at 10:00 AM (IST), with audio recording uploaded by **Hemangi Patil** and **Shailesh Patil** at the company’s website.

Canara Robeco's Q4 & FY26 earnings call (April 28, 2026) reported FY26 revenue from operations of ₹424.9 Cr (+17% YoY) and PAT of ₹203.8 Cr (+7%), with closing AUM of about ₹1.07 lakh Cr and cost-to-income guided at 40-50%.
Canara Bank disclosed under SEBI regulations that its promoter holding in Canara Robeco Asset Management Company Ltd is 38% as of March 31, 2026.
Canara Robeco Asset Management Company Ltd. will participate in Virtual Conference of Choice Institutional Equities on June 10, 2026, with Hemangi Patil and Shailesh Patil leading.
Canara Robeco reported a 21% YoY increase in Q2FY27 PAT to ₹59.2 Cr and declared an interim dividend of ₹2 per share.
